description:
Games and tools for Zwift ride leaders.

 * Score every nearby rider over a set duration and announce the standings and winners in chat.
 * Pick the game from a dropdown: Closest to Leader (lowest average distance from the ride leader) or Cadence Challenge (highest average RPM).
 * Staged chat sending (Silent / Review / Auto) with word-boundary chunking and paced delivery.
 * A bicycle-joke sender to entertain the group between efforts.

Sending chat requires Sauce's Game Connection to be enabled.
